package.name: cell_description
package.description: What every workcell shares: module descriptors (modules/*.yaml), module wrappers around vendor macros and the template's border and workcell-frame macros (urdf/), and cell_description.composition, which finds a workcell by name (ament index, cell_compositions) and loads its file with the descriptors, for tools/generate_cell.py, tools/check_composition.py and the launch files. Each workcell's own files are in its own package.
